name: neural-noise
title: Neural Noise
description: Animated CPPN-based neural noise rendered in WebGL. Produces continuously evolving organic color patterns driven by a compositional pattern-producing network.

usage.label: React

props.name: speed
props.description: Animation speed multiplier. Higher values make the pattern evolve faster.

props.name: color
props.description: Base color the pattern is tinted toward in its darker regions.

props.name: highlight-color
props.description: Highlight color the pattern is tinted toward in its brighter regions.
